description: Ministry of Public Administration & Management - Amendment No. 01 to the Service Minute of SL Information & Communication Technology Service
categorisation: This gazette notification contains revisions to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Information and Communication Technology Service, specifically regarding qualification requirements for promotion within the public service. It deals with public service recruitment, promotions, and service conditions, which falls under the Public Service Gazettes category (Type 8). The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with names, detailed ministerial portfolios, or any of the other specialized categories like land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
